evidence: X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements were carried out in ı/2ı scan mode using a Philips X’pert Pro MRD X-ray diffractometer with Cu K R radiation. Low-angle X-ray reflectivity (XRR) data were collected in 0.005° increments and 2 s count times. XRR data were analyzed with the WinGixa program, provided by Philips. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) spectra were measured on a Quantum 200 scanning microprobe spectrometer using monochromatic Al KR emission. The film thickness was determined by a spectroscopic ellipsometer (J. A. Woollam Co., Inc.) with a Cauchy dispersion model. Capacitance-voltage (C-V) characteristics were measured by a Keithley 236 source measurement unit and a Precision LCR meter (HP 4284A) at 10 kHz. Current-voltage (I-V) characteristics were measured by a Keithley 236 source measurement unit.
